scope: Desktop screenshots of two previously used sample areas; no current street survey or worldwide acceptance test.

sites.name: Kreuzberg, Berlin
sites.assessment: Candidate: more complete pavement footprint, legible junction corners and distinct material bands. Reduced slab contrast improves the initial preview.
limitations: Historical survey may not reflect later changes.
Generic yards and sharp mixed-road surface transitions remain.

sites.name: Main Street, Haworth
sites.assessment: Limited: paths and roadside paving are readable, but widths remain inferred and generic yards/land-cover boundaries still dominate some areas.
limitations: No explicitly mapped widths were found in the retained OSM pavement records for this sample.
